concerns.text: FR-003 mandates computing correlations on the *full synchronized dataset* (no storm filtering), but the Methodology sketch (and Idea.md) states that the analysis will *filter for geomagnetic storm events (Dst < −50 nT)*. This creates a direct contradiction about whether storm‑only data or the full continuous series should be used.

FR-003 contains an incomplete cross‑reference: "(see FR‑)" which does not resolve to any existing requirement ID. The intended reference is likely FR-010 (effective‑sample‑size adjustment). The broken reference should be corrected.
